clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says people call him constantly asking for help selling their book on how to manifest. His answer is always the same: "If you know how to manifest, what are you calling me for? Just manifest a bestseller."

He has manifested six number-one New York Times bestsellers, 100 million books sold, and companies that did more than $25 billion in sales. He wrote Your Wish Is Your Command only after he proved it worked on himself.

Comment "WISH" and I will send you the same material, free - no guru required who has not done it themselves.
